Our Promise

Monarch Surveyors & Engineering Consultants Ltd. is a leading publicly listed firm specializing in Consultancy, Detail Design, Engineering survey, Environment & Social Feasibility studies.

 

With over 30 years of experience, we deliver comprehensive solutions for infrastructure projects, including Rail, Roads, Metro, Urban planning, Geospatial mapping, land acquisition, water & Energy
